The competitor, OmniFit, has introduced a subscription model for fitness equipment that allows consumers to upgrade to the latest models for a monthly fee. This strategy shifts the traditional ownership model to a service-based consumption model, which could significantly alter market dynamics by lowering the barrier to entry for high-end equipment and appealing to customers who value convenience and up-to-date technology.

For our business, this presents a competitive threat as it may erode our customer base if we remain rigid in our pricing and ownership structures. To retain customer loyalty and stay relevant, we should consider evaluating similar innovative pricing strategies, such as offering flexible subscription options, trade-in programs, or tiered service packages. Adapting to this shift in consumer preference for access over ownership will be crucial for maintaining our market position.
